description: The covers trace (GX-29, B-13, D-070): the hermetic harness records the files a Python script test opens, and the test reports the ones outside its declared covers. Report-only.

gate-trace.covers_trace_ignore.description: Paths (relative to the checkout) the trace never reports: the registry every config.get reads, generated modules, the decisions file every unit-manifest load reads, the harness itself, VCS, toolchain, dependencies and bytecode.

gate-trace.covers_trace_max_listed.description: Most undeclared paths one test lists in its trace report; the count of the rest is printed.

gate-trace.covers_trace_mode.description: report: a Python script test lists, on stderr at exit, the files it read outside its declared covers (never a failure). off: nothing is recorded. A blocking mode is a later decision.
